# Draft:Stewart McIntyre

----
Stewart McIntyre is a Scottish roofer from West Lothian, Scotland, frequently described as “West Lothian’s finest roofer” by clients, acquaintances, and, on at least one occasion, Stewart McIntyre himself. He is best known for his work on roofs, most of which remain watertight.
Early life
Stewart McIntyre was born in West Lothian, where he was exposed to roofs from an early age. Historians disagree on the precise moment he decided to become a roofer, though it is generally accepted that it involved a ladder.
Career
McIntyre entered the roofing trade after acquiring a working knowledge of tiles, slates, and gravity. His early career consisted largely of fixing other people’s mistakes, a practice he continues to this day.
Over time, McIntyre became known for:
Completing jobs he said he would complete
Turning up when he said he would turn up
Leaving roofs in a better condition than he found them
These achievements, while modest, set him apart within the local roofing ecosystem.
Claim to excellence
The title “West Lothian’s finest roofer” is not officially regulated and carries no formal accreditation. Nevertheless, it persists. Contributing factors include:
Roofs that do not leak
Prices that do not cause immediate distress
A noticeable absence of cowboy behaviour
Attempts to challenge the title have been rare and largely unsuccessful.
Techniques and materials
McIntyre is known to work with:
Slates
Tiles
Felt
Other things commonly found on roofs
He is widely believed to prefer “doing it properly” over “doing it quickly and hoping for the best.”
Public image
Despite his local reputation, McIntyre has avoided national fame. He does not seek publicity and has never been involved in a roofing-related scandal, which some critics argue is overdue.
Personal life
Very little is known about McIntyre’s personal life. It is believed he owns at least one jacket suitable for bad weather.
Legacy
Stewart McIntyre’s legacy can be seen across West Lothian in the form of roofs that continue to function as roofs. Future roofers are expected to benefit from his example, or at least be compared unfavourably to it.

References
This article relies heavily on hearsay, local legend, and roofs that have not collapsed.
External links
None. He’s a roofer, not a content creator.
